description: Renewal of the Memorandum of Understanding on Search and Rescue Cooperation between the National Search and Rescue Agency of Indonesia and the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka, as a signatory State to the Chicago Convention of the International Civil Aviation Organization, is responsible for providing search and rescue operations to assist any aircraft or ship that meets any accident within the 625,000 square nautical miles of airspace allocated to the country. It is possible for the State concerned to enter into Agreements with neighbouring States to enhance cooperation and coordination in search and rescue operations in accordance with the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Convention on Search and Rescue. Since Sri Lanka and Indonesia are neighbouring countries which share the South-Eastern boundary of the Colombo Flight Information Region, a Memorandum of Understanding on Search and Rescue Cooperation has been signed between the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka and the National Search and the Rescue Agency of Indonesia on 2018-01-24 to be effective for a period of 05 years. Although the approval of the Cabinet has been granted to extend the enforcement period of the said Agreement on 2023-02-13, Agreements concerned have not yet been signed. Taking the aforesaid matter into account, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to take necessary action to renew the said MoU for a period of 05 years commencing from the year 2025, was approved by the Cabinet.
